approximations: Interconnect energy uses Timeloop's Legacy network model with one shared 45nm wire constant and per-architecture switching terms (archs/_shared/noc.yaml); hop distance is derived by Timeloop from each level's Accelergy area. The recon arm scales the WEIGHT share of NoC energy by K/N like the other on-chip categories.
exact stored codeword count x measured DRAM refetch factor; parity + message padding; rounded up to whole DRAM words once

External parity is billed at the measured per-access energy of a DRAM weight read on this architecture, not at an independently modelled parity-region access cost. That is exact if parity is read from the same DRAM by the same controller, which is the conventional-ECC assumption.

facts.label: Input stationary
facts.accumulator_evidence: Matched to its two sibling reference dataflows so that the three simple designs differ only in which operand is stationary.
facts.citation: Authored in this repository, 2026-09-06.  timeloop-accelergy-exercises ships no input-stationary design and no paper is being reproduced. Built as the exact mirror of simple_weight_stationary and simple_output_stationary -- same mesh, same buffer capacities, same word widths -- with the PE scratchpad holding Inputs instead of Weights or Outputs, per section 9 of 01_project_context_and_architectures.txt.

provenance.source_document: authored in this repository 2026-09-06; NO paper, nothing shipped upstream

pe_spad.rationale: Deliberately identical to the weight-stationary sibling except for which dataspace it keeps, so the three simple designs differ only in the dataflow. See archs/simple_input_stationary/README.md.

dataflow_constraints.temporal: M innermost at pe_spad -- a resident activation is reused across filters

mapper_settings.seed_note: timeloop-mapper v4 exposes no random seed; pytimeloop's Mapper spec has no `random_seed` attribute. ECC_MAPPER_SEED is RECORDED so a result says which value was asked for, but it does not make the search deterministic. What does bound it is the thread count and victory condition, both of which are in the fingerprint -- so pin ECC_MAPPER_THREADS for a reproducible run rather than leaving it at 'all cores', which differs per machine.
